properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued July 29 at 10:03PM MDT until July 30 at 1:00AM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southeastern Lincoln County in east central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 100 AM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry creeks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 1003 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.

- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Wild Horse Point.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 29 at 9:00PM MDT until July 30 at 12:00AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
FFWPUB

The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Crowley County in southeastern Colorado...
Northwestern Otero County in southeastern Colorado...
Northeastern Pueblo County in southeastern Colorado...

* Until midnight MDT.

* At 900 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Rocky Ford, Fowler, Ordway, Swink, Manzanola, Olney Springs, Sugar
City and Crowley.
